before: Word motion, word deletion, and double-click word selection could cross an inline control edge.
after: Word motion, word deletion, and double-click word selection stop at both edges of every inline control, whatever its lock.
reason: Word deletion sends the existing deleteText operation over a shorter range; no field or format changes. Two mounted editors cover body and header navigation, remote selections, concurrent edits, undo, redo, deletion during peer input, word deletion beside a peer typing inside the control, convergence, and save/reopen.
